bands.title: Data Engineering & Consulting for Enterprise-Scale Outcomes
Most Enterprises Don’t Lack Data - They Lack the Infrastructure to Use It
bands.lead: After years of platform investments, the reality for most mid-to-large enterprises is a fragmented, expensive, and underperforming data landscape. Tools accumulate. Pipelines break. Teams firefight. ROI disappears into complexity. This is the problem Ignitho was built to solve – not by adding more technology, but by applying Frugal Innovation: making what you already own work at its full potential

items.title: Manual Bottlenecks & Pipeline Debt
items.body: Complex ETL pipelines requiring extensive manual maintenance, causing IT dependency and delivery delays that block business decisions

items.title: Disconnected Data Silos
items.body: Data trapped across cloud APIs, legacy files, and SaaS platforms – fragmented ecosystems that make unified reporting impossible without manual intervention

items.title: Data Quality & Decision Risk
items.body: Frequent inconsistencies and errors in source data that cascade into unreliable dashboards, delayed board reporting, and flawed strategic decisions

items.title: Cloud Cost Overruns
items.body: Poorly optimized queries, uncompressed data formats, and over-provisioned infrastructure that inflate cloud bills while delivering no additional insight

items.title: Real-Time Data Streaming & Pipeline Engineering
items.body: Our data engineering practice covers the full data platform lifecycle – from raw ingestion through to business-ready intelligence layers. Every engagement is anchored to your existing technology investments, not a new vendor stack

items.title: Modern Data Warehouse & Lakehouse Design
items.body: Build event-driven, low-latency data pipelines that move, transform, and validate data at speed. We architect streaming infrastructure on Kafka, Kinesis, and Azure Event Hubs – enabling real-time decisioning, fraud detection, and operational intelligence without overhauling your existing landscape

items.title: ETL/ELT Pipeline Optimization & Reliability Engineering
items.body: Rescue, stabilize, and optimize broken or inefficient data pipelines. We audit ETL processes, rewrite transformations, remove manual interventions, and implement monitoring

items.title: Cloud Migration & Platform Modernization
items.body: Implement data quality frameworks, automated testing, and observability tooling. We build Great Expectations suites, Monte Carlo integrations, and dbt testing layers

items.title: Data Quality, Governance & Observability
items.body: Independent advisory for CDOs, CIOs, and Heads of Data Engineering to evaluate architecture, make stack decisions, and build a pragmatic roadmap

bands.title: From Discovery to Production - In Weeks, Not Quarters
bands.lead: Ignitho’s delivery model is anchored in short, outcome-focused cycles. We do not run long discovery phases, produce dense architecture documents, and then disappear for six months. Every phase produces a tangible, measurable deliverable

items.title: 7-Day Triage & Discovery
items.body: Rapid assessment of your current data stack, pipeline inventory, and key pain points

items.title: Sprint Zero - Architecture & Planning
items.body: Define the target architecture, data contracts, and delivery milestones

items.title: Iterative Delivery - 7 to 30-Day Sprints
items.body: Outcome-driven sprints with continuous feedback and deployed deliverables

items.title: Stabilize, Optimize & Handover
items.body: Production hardening, performance tuning, documentation,& enablement

bands.title: Specialist PODs - Self-Contained, Outcome-Driven, Day-1 Productive
bands.lead: Ignitho deploys self-contained Specialist PODs: cross-functional delivery units that combine Human Intelligence (senior practitioners), Artificial Intelligence (automation and AI agents), and Technology Intelligence (your existing platforms). Each POD integrates into your existing Agile/Jira workflow on Day 1. There is no ramp-up theatre, no management overhead, and no hand-holding required. Your engineers get time back, not a new team to manage

items.title: Single point of accountability
items.body: One POD Leader owns delivery and acts as your primary interface. No diffuse responsibility, no finger-pointing between teams

items.title: Agile velocity: 7 to 30-day sprint cycles
items.body: Short, continuous delivery cycles with visible progress at every sprint review. Business stakeholders see outcomes, not activity metrics

items.title: Plug-and-play integration
items.body: Works within your existing tools, governance frameworks, and operating models. No disruptive change management. No rip-and-replace mentality

items.title: AI-augmented delivery speed
items.body: Automated data quality validation, AI-assisted code review, and accelerator libraries built into the POD reduce delivery time by up to 40%
